codeManifestHash.description: Content identity of the revision's code paths only (C2). Stamped beside manifestHash so a code-scoped verdict can outlive a governance-text edit; absent when the split cannot be derived, in which case a code-scoped binding refuses to match.

governanceManifestHash.description: The governance-text surface at the time of this verdict (§22/§24). A text-only edit expires what this surface was verified for, and nothing else.

instrumentManifestHash.description: The declared-instrument surface at the time of this verdict (§24.4). Editing a declared instrument expires the instrument surface only — not the pass about the deliverable.

candidateFreezeSha256.description: The frozen candidate this verdict answered (§7.4). Stamped beside the manifest so the conclusion binds to the reviewed content and semantic contract rather than to the declared owned paths, which cannot see a change committed outside the declaration.

supersededComparison.description: The comparison behind a drift verdict, as a union of the two states that produce one. `content-moved` names the declared paths whose own digests differ; `declaration-moved` names the declared sets that disagree — in that state the manifest itself is equal, so no differing path is listed. Present only for those two verdicts, because they are otherwise unwitnessable: the scope names no file, and the map an operator can diff (`contentDigests`) is built by the filtered walk and so excludes exactly the declared paths that can move invisibly. The union is enforced with `oneOf`, not merely labelled with `kind`: an independent round measured a labelled-only version accepting `content-moved` with no paths, which is the false statement this field exists to make impossible.

kind.description: Which comparison produced the verdict. The four are different facts and are kept apart rather than recorded as one with an empty list.

revisionId.description: The revision the comparison is about.

differingPaths.description: For `content-moved`: each declared path whose own digest differs, with both sides. At least one, because content drift is a change to some path's digest: the manifest hashes the declared paths and their content, so it cannot move while every path agrees.

recorded.description: The digest the seal recorded for this path, or null when it recorded none.

observed.description: The digest the same derivation gives now, or null when the path is gone.

added.description: For `declaration-moved`: declared by the task, not carried by the revision.

removed.description: For `declaration-moved`: carried by the revision, no longer declared by the task.

kindChanges.description:
The paths whose kind changed, each with both sides (`content`/`directory`/`missing`/`unsupported`, or null when the path
 was not in that side's map). Attached to `kind-moved` (where it is the whole comparison) and to `content-moved` when the same
 move changed a path's kind as well.

reason.description: For `unnameable`: why no path could be named — a revision that recorded no path kinds, or a move invisible to both comparisons.

frozenContractHash.description: For `contract-moved`: the acceptance contract the revision froze.

taskContractHash.description: For `contract-moved`: the acceptance contract the task carries now, after the amendment.

oneOf.description: Content drift: at least one declared path's content differs, with both sides.

A moved declaration: the declared sets disagree, so there is no differing path to list — and at least one of the two is non-empty, because two equal sets are not a move (a round measured this branch accepting two empty sets, the same empty-list lie the content branch refuses).
A move in kind only: the content comparison names nothing, so the kind comparison does.
The manifest moved and neither comparison could name a path; the reason is carried instead of an empty list.

The acceptance contract was amended after the seal: the revision froze one contract and the task carries another. Both hashes are required, because the contract is one value and there is no path to name.
